source.description: First image in the Calendar correction message: four Calendar variants on a dark Figma canvas.
source.note: Fresh Figma context was quota-limited. Visual decisions use the supplied screenshot; metadata only confirms known dimensions. This is not a fresh Figma export.

geometry.note: Padding/header placement is inferred from the screenshot and checked with a browser capture at the same scale. Month height changes with its real week count.

icons.note: Original Calendar navigation exports from the DatePicker 340:1018 context replace the earlier rotated Select chevron. No text glyph or SVG approximation.

decisions: The reference contains September 31. Keep actual Gregorian dates: September has 30 days and October 1 is Thursday in 2026.
Leading grid slots remain blank as in the screenshot; trailing dates are visible, muted and disabled.
Weekday text uses the existing accessible secondary token instead of the reference's low-contrast gray.
Range-start text uses the existing link token on the pale selected background; borders/middle/end retain the brand-blue tokens.
The existing widget remains immediate single-date selection. Draft/range options are independent component state, not new AFDocument fields.
A separate DatePicker input/popover is outside this Calendar correction.
